title: Multiple Choice - Direct Questions
description: Choose the best answer for each question.

questions.text: Which phrase refers to the existence of a variety of cultural or ethnic groups within a single society?
What is the process by which businesses, cultures, and societies develop international influence and operate globally?
Which term describes the feeling of confusion and disorientation experienced by someone visiting an unfamiliar culture?
What do we call a distinctive, iconic dish that a particular region or town is especially famous for preparing?
Which decorative item is made by carving a scary or funny face into a pumpkin and placing a candle inside?
What is a festive public celebration, typically involving parades, masquerade costumes, music, and street dancing?
Which traditional contest involves two opposing teams pulling on opposite ends of a thick rope until one team crosses a line?
What term refers to an interesting place or historic monument that travelers visit for leisure and sightseeing?
Which verb means to completely hold the attention and interest of someone by being extremely interesting or charming?
Which phrase describes a school club, sport, or hobby pursued by students outside the regular academic classroom curriculum?
